problem: Lexus USB audio stopped after the hold switch was moved on and off; only a replug restored it.
mechanism: Inferred, not captured: one failed/short isochronous packet stops the non-native batch pump in IRQ context, and only a host SET_CUR/SET_INTERFACE restarted it, which a car that keeps polling never sends.
fix: USB-thread restart of a fault-stopped stream while the host keeps alternate 1 enabled, with bounded backoff; hold-switch and restart diagnostics in the USB log.
